Gauri Bansal | gauri.bansal756@example.com | +91 9122034990
Chennai
Notice period: 30 days

Professional Summary
Senior Data Engineer with deep experience designing and operating scalable data pipelines and analytics platforms. Strong background in cloud data warehousing, batch and streaming ETL, and production monitoring. Proven track record delivering performant data models and automation to support retail analytics and enterprise reporting.

Technical Skills
Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, PySpark, Agile, Linux, Jira

Work Experience

Senior Data Engineer, Quanta Retail (Aug 2022 - Present)
- Designed and implemented Snowflake-based curated data models for sales and inventory analytics; reduced query latency by 45% through clustering and micro-partition pruning using SQL and Snowflake features.
- Built PySpark ETL jobs to ingest and transform terabytes of daily POS and web event data, improving end-to-end pipeline throughput by 30% and enabling near-real-time dashboards.
- Orchestrated multi-step pipelines with Apache Airflow, adding automated alerting and retry logic to achieve 99.8% pipeline success rate and reduce manual interventions.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints, using Jira to track stories and drive continuous delivery of data products for merchandising and demand forecasting teams.

Big Data Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services (Nov 2017 - Jul 2022)
- Developed large-scale Apache Spark jobs in Python to process customer and transaction datasets for enterprise reporting; optimized jobs to cut cluster time by 40% through partitioning and caching.
- Implemented Airflow DAGs to schedule complex ETL workflows and integrated job metrics and logging on Linux-based clusters to improve observability.
- Migrated legacy ETL scripts to PySpark and standardized SQL-based transformations, resulting in consistent data quality and a 25% reduction in data reconciliation issues.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies, tracked deliverables in Jira, and supported cross-functional teams in delivering data pipelines for analytics and BI consumers.

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
